notes.title: V0.2
notes.content:
1. New Features
1.1. New Characters Added
The player character is replaced with a new one. Several new NPC characters have been added.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577081/b9786280ecd12101cda7fb9699c724eb31d85617.jpg
1.2. 10 New Levels Added
New levels include scenarios like a fire in an underground parking lot and climbing to rescue people.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577081/85aa1ec8ddd938423df90c917a136e7d65c567d3.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577081/40d389c54da0e205b18e72aeda70b02107fff23f.jpg
1.3. Weather Options Added
You can now select weather conditions like sunny, rainy, snowy, and foggy.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577081/97c888b474cc050ecc8cb5c6b8ec0e45e218a897.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577081/729257c164e72742a254cfc4cc4ea402a84c5ce5.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577081/5b3ed0fa58a893cf2cfb9907ee120a689b436148.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577081/1eca85f4fc745354cb4581fab24dc6fcee047227.jpg
1.4. Others
Added the ability to skip the opening and ending cutscenes.
2. Fixes
Fixed numerous bugs.
